column3: Menardi took the Stars\nand your friends down the\nlift. She waits below.{end_wait}
Where? Where is Jenna!?{end_wait}
Where you cannot follow\nbefore it is finished.\nI am sorry for that.{end_wait}
Sorry will not bring Jenna\nback. Nothing will.{end_wait}
Then try to follow. I will\nnot stop you again.{end_wait}
Mia went ahead alone!\nMenardi will cut her down.{end_wait}
Then she will not face her\nalone. Move!{end_wait}
...{end_wait}
She's gone. We have to go\nafter her!{end_wait}
You.{pause_20_skippable} I knew you would\nfollow me here.{end_wait}
Yes. Her. Finish what\nyou started, healer. We\nwould not stop you.{end_wait}
Who are you? I don't\nknow you! Please, don't!{end_wait}
...She doesn't know me.\nThe other one would have\nlaughed.{end_wait}
Menardi. Give them back.{end_wait}
Alone, in this light? You\nare either brave, or lost.{end_wait}
Neither. I'm angry.{end_wait}
Enough... the light is\ntoo strong. The Stars are\nalready ours.{end_wait}
The captives come with\nme. Follow, if you dare.{end_wait}
Mia! Are you hurt?{end_wait}
Menardi took them all.\nJenna, Kraden, Felix, and\nthe Stars.{end_wait}
Then we follow. Together\nthis time.{end_wait}
...Together. Fine.{end_wait}
